verdict.rationale: Obsidian publishes help and developer documentation, so offering an llms.txt or agent-oriented docs is a fair ask, but nothing in the evidence shows either. The Headless Sync page mentions agents as a use case for syncing, but that is an automation feature, not documentation built for agents to read. The docs happen to live as plain Markdown on GitHub, but no evidence presents them as an agent-facing docs entry point.
